tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The app frame: title bar, sidebar, the gutter between split panes. The deepest layer; content never sits directly on it except sidebar rows.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The working canvas: chat thread, editor page, settings body.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Things that sit on the canvas: assistant message cards, the composer, tool-call cards, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating layers: menus, the model picker, popovers, the selection toolbar, tooltips. Always paired with shadow-lg.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash laid over any surface (sidebar rows, ghost buttons, menu items). Translucent so it works on every layer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes). Holds 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on night, every surface, iris-soft and horizon-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, labels, sidebar previews, inactive icons. On night, every surface and iris-soft.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, timestamps, token counts, struck-through text in a suggestion. On night and every surface; still 4.5:1.

tokens.name: iris
tokens.usage: The one interactive color: primary buttons, links, focus, the active conversation, split pane A. As text, on night, every surface and iris-soft.

tokens.name: iris-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind iris or ink text: the selected sidebar row, the user's message bubble, an active toggle.

tokens.name: on-iris
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an iris fill (primary button label, send button arrow). Dark, because iris is light.

tokens.name: dusk
tokens.usage: Agents and tools: tool-call headers, the running spinner, MCP/tool badges. As text, on night, every surface and dusk-soft.

tokens.name: dusk-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind dusk text: a tool badge, the agent-mode toggle when on.

tokens.name: horizon
tokens.usage: Creative writing: suggestion marks, inserted text, the writing-tools toolbar accent, split pane B. As text, on night, every surface and horizon-soft.

tokens.name: horizon-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind inserted text in a suggestion and behind horizon labels.

tokens.name: on-horizon
tokens.usage: Text on a horizon fill (the B chip in split compare, Accept on a suggestion).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, connected, model online. Always with a word or icon. As text, on night and every surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Rate limits, context nearly full, a tool waiting for approval. Always with a word or icon. As text, on night and every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed tool calls, destructive actions. Always with a word or icon. As text, on night, every surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind an error message or a failed tool call.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (the confirm button in a destructive dialog).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring color — an alias of iris; see the focus-ring shadow.

tokens.name: pane-a
tokens.usage: Split compare: marks everything belonging to the left (original) pane.

tokens.name: pane-b
tokens.usage: Split compare: marks everything belonging to the right (cloned) pane. Blue vs orange, so A and B are never told apart by a red/green hue.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection highlight in chat and the editor (::selection).

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Geist, bundled with the app. Dense and quiet: 14px is the working size.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty-state greeting and onboarding only. Never in a thread.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Conversation title in the header, dialog titles, settings page titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside panels and settings; headings inside assistant markdown.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Summarize the last three scenes and flag continuity errors.
styles.usage: Chat messages, form fields, menu items — the default.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, field labels, sidebar conversation titles.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, badges, tool-call status lines.

groups.name: Writing
groups.note: Literata, bundled with the app. Only on the manuscript surface — the place the user's own words live.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: The lamps came on one street at a time, as if the town were remembering itself.
styles.usage: Body text in the writing editor and in split panes set to Writing view.

styles.name: prose-heading
styles.usage: Chapter and scene headings in the editor.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Geist Mono, bundled with the app.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, tool arguments and results, model IDs, keyboard shortcuts.

spacing.note: 4px base. Chat is dense; the editor breathes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; gap between toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding in dense lists; sidebar row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Message card and composer padding; gap between messages.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters around the thread; between settings sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Editor page margins; empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of the editor page; empty-state hero offset.

radius.note: Soft corners, tightening as things get smaller. Pills only for status and model chips.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, keyboard keys, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, sidebar rows, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Message cards, tool-call cards, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The composer, dialogs, split panes.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Model chips, status dots, the send button.

shadow.note: Twilight separates layers by tone first; shadows only lift floating things.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The composer and inputs at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, the model picker, popovers, the selection toolbar — anything floating. Includes a 1px edge.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px canvas-colored gap, then 2px of solid iris. Applied with :focus-visible.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of the app shell and controls.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar and icon buttons, chips.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: titlebar
tokens.usage: Window title bar and pane headers.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Conversation sidebar width (collapsible).

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: Max width of a chat thread or composer in a single pane.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the writing editor's text column (~70 characters of prose).
